seams.reason: the system's virtual memory: reserving, committing, decommitting and releasing whole pages of one reservation through mmap, mprotect and NtAllocateVirtualMemory, each call asserting that its pages are whole and inside the reservation
memory read as another type: bytes as items of a type, and an interface's opaque context as its implementation, each asserting the alignment and length that make the view hold

flat's zero-copy reads: a view is one pointer into an image that verify checked or a builder wrote, so a read carries no length, as a hand-written reader's does; alignment is asserted where it matters
what secret computation asks of the machine below the language: AArch64's DIT register, the kernel's HWCAP word, the stack just below a frame, and an optimizer barrier

a validated state machine's comptime tables read at run time: positions of valid enum values index them and every cell is a state's position or none, so the reads keep their checks in Debug and read as a hand-written table past it

disallowed.replacement: return the work and let the caller start it
